notes.title: Goldenjar Fall - Definitive Edition is here!
notes.content:
Dear brothers, fellow adventurers!

As we stand on the precipice of a new dawn, our hearts resonate with an overwhelming sense of gratitude and awe. Today, we are not just unveiling an update! We are celebrating an epic chapter in the chronicles of Goldenjar Fall. It is a chapter authored not just by the diligent hands within our development studios but, more significantly, by the indomitable spirit of our community. From the early days, when Goldenjar Fall was but a vision in the minds of our creators, you, our community, embraced the call to adventure supporting us through the Early Access phase. 
Your unwavering support has been the bedrock upon which we've built this world. Your suggestions, critiques, and the passion that emanates from your gaming experiences have become the north star guiding us through the ever-expanding cosmos of game development.

[previewyoutube=Ajxy-uTk_tw;full][/previewyoutube]
Today, we raise our digital hammers in salute to this Definitive Edition which is not a mere update: it is a heartfelt expression of gratitude to each and every adventurer who has made Korik's journey more than just a game! So, let the trumpets sound, the drums beat, and the banners unfurl, 
for the Goldenjar Fall -Definitive Edition! 

[h3]WHAT'S NEW?[/h3]

📚 Revamped Tutorial Systems
Embark on your quest with confidence! The new tutorial systems are meticulously crafted to guide both newcomers and seasoned warriors through the intricacies of Goldenjar Fall. Learn the ropes, master the mechanics, and become the true hero you were meant to be.

🎮 New Keybinding System
Tailor your controls to match your playstyle with our brand-new keybinding system. Enjoy the flexibility of customizing your controls for the ultimate gaming comfort.

⚡ Korik's Powers Cooldown
Time your moves wisely, and unleash your abilities at the perfect moment for maximum impact.
[h3]
FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h3]

👁️ Improved Visibility
We've raised Korik's feedback box, ensuring that crucial information is easily visible in the heat of battle. No more missed insights, stay informed, stay victorious!

🌟 Enhanced Tutorial Highlights
Navigate Level 1 with ease! A second highlight point has been introduced as part of the revised tutorial, offering additional clarity on your heroic journey.

🗣️ Revised Feedback Texts
Korik's guidance has been fine-tuned to align seamlessly with the new tutorial. Clearer instructions pave the way for a smoother adventure.

📖 Engaging Introduction
Experience a more captivating start with a refined introduction text. Immerse yourself in the Goldenjar Fall world from the very beginning.

🌐 Global Readability
Language barriers are a thing of the past! Korik's feedback is now universally readable, no matter the language you choose for your epic adventure.

🌈 Visual and Narrative Polish
The game's tone has been perfected, offering a more immersive and engaging narrative experience. Dive deeper into the Goldenjar Fall universe!

⚖️ Balanced Combat Experience
Enemy interactions and combat statistics have undergone adjustments for a more balanced and rewarding gameplay experience. Face your foes with newfound confidence!

🕰️ Updated Enemy Reaction Times
Enemies now react more dynamically, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement to your encounters. Prepare for more intense battles!

🚫 Flicker-Free Gameplay
Bid farewell to the pesky issue of Korik flickering on certain levels, enjoy seamless gameplay without any distractions

Stay legendary, brothers!
[b]
BUY GOLDENJAR FALL - DEFINITIVE EDITION NOW[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631010/Goldenjar_Fall/

notes.title: Goldenjar Fall Update!
notes.content:
[b]Dear adventurers,[/b]

We have exciting news to share with all of you. Get ready to experience a series of enhancements that will improve your gaming experience and journey through the Dwarven Halls.

[u]Reset Your Talent Tree:[/u]
Have you ever wished you could reset your Talent Tree and experiment with different configurations without worrying about previous decisions? Now you can! The Goldenjar Fall update allows you to reset your Talent Tree so you can adapt it to your current playstyle. Every time you break a weapon, you will improve your damage with axes and additionally gain a point to reset your talent tree.

[u]Walk While Holding Click:[/u]
Comfort is essential when embarking on epic adventures! With our latest update, we've fixed the "walk while holding click" feature. Now, you can explore by simply holding down the button as you venture into the halls of Goldenjar.

These are just some of the improvements you'll find in the Goldenjar Fall update. We are committed to providing you with the best gaming experience possible, and this update is part of that commitment.

So, what are you waiting for? Update your game right now, and may Torgabarath guide you on your journey.

Stay legendary, brothers!
[b]
BUY GOLDENJAR FALL - DEFINITIVE EDITION NOW[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631010/Goldenjar_Fall/

notes.title: Announcing the Latest GoldenJar Fall Update!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce a recent hotfix that brings several significant improvements:

[b]Combat Enhancement: [/b]We have worked tirelessly to perfect the way you engage with your enemies, ensuring that the combat experience is smoother and more thrilling than ever.

[b]Enhanced Interaction:[/b] We have refined how Korik interacts with objects in the world, allowing you to immerse yourself even more in the story and adventure.

[b]Equipment Errors Corrected:[/b] We have addressed the issue of the incorrect weapon that some players were experiencing in the ruins level.

We hope these enhancements make your gaming experience more enjoyable than ever before! Keep exploring and enjoying your adventure in our virtual world!
